name: Boston
housing: Boston's rentals are largely triple-deckers and brick row houses, with many student apartments in Allston, Brighton and Mission Hill.

localRules.text: Boston requires all private rental units to be registered with the city every year by July 1 and to be inspected under its rental registration and inspection program.

climate: Test the heat and photograph windows and radiators; winters are cold and snowy, and old buildings can be drafty.
fact: Most Boston leases start on September 1, so move-in day is the busiest of the year.
